# Azure Cost & Compliance Monitor
---
Real-time visibility into Azure spend anomalies, resource costs, endpoint compliance, and AKS container health.

content.query:
AzureCostData_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize TotalDailyCost = sum(DailyCost_d) by Date_s, IsAnomaly_b
| extend Status = iff(IsAnomaly_b == true, '⚠️ Anomaly', 'Normal')
| order by Date_s asc
| project Date_s, TotalDailyCost, Status
content.title: 30 Day Spend Trend

content.query:
let CostThresholdPct = 30;
let CostThresholdAbs = 5.0;
let CostBaseline =
    AzureCostData_CL
    | where IsAnomaly_b == false
    | summarize
        AvgDailyResourceCost = round(sum(DailyCost_d) / 29, 2),
        StdDev = stdev(DailyCost_d)
        by ResourceType, ResourceGroup
    | where isnotempty(ResourceGroup);
AzureCostData_CL
| where IsAnomaly_b == true
| summarize
    TodayCost = round(sum(DailyCost_d), 2),
    RecordCount = count()
    by ResourceType, ResourceGroup
| join kind=inner CostBaseline on ResourceType, ResourceGroup
| extend CostIncrease = round(TodayCost - AvgDailyResourceCost, 2)
| extend PercentageIncrease = round((CostIncrease / AvgDailyResourceCost) * 100, 2)
| extend DeviationsFromNormal = round(CostIncrease / StdDev, 2)
| where PercentageIncrease > CostThresholdPct and CostIncrease > CostThresholdAbs
| order by CostIncrease desc
| project ResourceGroup, ResourceType, TodayCost, AvgDailyResourceCost, CostIncrease, PercentageIncrease, DeviationsFromNormal
content.title: Cost Anomalies Detected

content.query:
AzureCostData_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize
    TotalCost = round(sum(DailyCost_d), 2),
    AvgDailyCost = round(avg(DailyCost_d), 2),
    MaxDailyCost = round(max(DailyCost_d), 2),
    DaysActive = dcount(Date_s)
    by ResourceName_s, ResourceType
| extend MonthlyCostProjection = round(AvgDailyCost * 30, 2)
| extend CostRating = case(
    AvgDailyCost > 50, '🔴 High',
    AvgDailyCost > 20, '🟡 Medium',
    '🟢 Low')
| order by TotalCost desc
| project ResourceName_s, ResourceType, TotalCost, AvgDailyCost, MaxDailyCost, MonthlyCostProjection, DaysActive, CostRating
content.title: Top Spending Resources

content.query:
IntuneComplianceData_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize
    TotalChecks = count(),
    CompliantChecks = countif(IsCompliant_b == true),
    NonCompliantChecks = countif(IsCompliant_b == false)
    by Date_s
| extend ComplianceRate = round((todouble(CompliantChecks) / todouble(TotalChecks)) * 100, 2)
| order by Date_s asc
| project Date_s, TotalChecks, CompliantChecks, NonCompliantChecks, ComplianceRate
content.title: 30 Day Compliance Rate Trend

content.query:
IntuneComplianceData_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where IsComplianceDrift_b == true
| summarize
    DriftCount = count(),
    AffectedDevices = make_set(DeviceName_s),
    AffectedUsers = make_set(UserName_s)
    by Date_s, Department_s, PolicyName_s
| order by Date_s desc
| project Date_s, Department_s, PolicyName_s, DriftCount, AffectedDevices, AffectedUsers
content.title: Compliance Drift Events

content.query:
KubePodInventory
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| summarize
    TotalPods = dcount(Name),
    RunningPods = dcountif(Name, PodStatus == 'Running'),
    FailedPods = dcountif(Name, PodStatus == 'Failed'),
    PendingPods = dcountif(Name, PodStatus == 'Pending')
    by ClusterName, Namespace
| extend HealthScore = round((todouble(RunningPods) / todouble(TotalPods)) * 100, 2)
| project ClusterName, Namespace, TotalPods, RunningPods, FailedPods, PendingPods, HealthScore
content.title: AKS Pod Health Status

content.query:
KubePodInventory
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ContainerRestartCount > 0
| summarize
    TotalRestarts = sum(ContainerRestartCount),
    AffectedPods = dcount(Name)
    by ClusterName, Namespace, ContainerName
| order by TotalRestarts desc
| project ClusterName, Namespace, ContainerName, TotalRestarts, AffectedPods
content.title: Container Restart Detection
